messages:
nina: dropping a quick screenshot of the Compliance > Policies list. thinking about a compact collapsed state where actions live in the header. screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc/policies (frame: collapsed-compact) - can we sanity-check order, copy, and a11y?

.tom: quick gut: reorder chips to put region first. Most enterprise users scan for data residency immediately.

priya: Copy: avoid the phrase 'Managed key' alone. It's ambiguous. Options: `Redwood-managed` | `Customer-managed (BYOK)`. Keep parens for BYOK.

ava: UX: Header action should be an icon button in collapsed state (pencil/edit). tooltip text = `Edit retention policy`. Expanded panel keeps full-primary CTA. Make sure icon has aria-label.

jordan: Audit log: please include old and new values, actor, and kms_owner. e.g. include kms_owner=customer or =redwood. Dont rely on freeform text only.

liz: Microcopy suggestions: chips: `eu-west-1` (region), `90 days` (retention), `Customer-managed (BYOK)` (encryption). If region is unset show `Region: Unspecified` not `Global`.

katie: A11y notes: header button must be keyboard reachable and part of tab order. When expanding the accordion, put a short aria-live=\"polite\" summary: \"Policy details expanded for 90-day retention\". Also test with NVDA.

nina: small responsive note: on mobile the header icon can stay but should be at least 44px tap target. Also when there are many policies the header icon should not push title truncation.

.tom: extra nit: use an inline separator between chips (· or middot) only for visual, but ensure screen reader reads them as separate elements (aria-label on each chip).

jordan: example audit event (suggested schema for backend):
```
2025-03-12T09:12:01Z policy.change actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_998 action=retention:update before=30d after=90d kms_owner=customer region=eu-west-1 note=\"via console\"
```

.priya: Also include a human-friendly audit message for the UI logs: `Retention policy updated from 30 days to 90 days by liz@example.com (Key: Customer-managed (BYOK))`.

.ava: Agree on both machine and human messages. Also: avoid implying Redwood can access customer keys. Use verbage like `Customer-managed (BYOK) - key stored in customer's KMS`.

.liz: Ill draft the copy PR with the chip examples and tooltip text.

.katie: Ill run a quick keyboard and screenreader pass on the prototype this afternoon and post issues.

.product-bot: New design comment added to Figma by nina: \"collapsed header: icon action + region-first chips\" (automated).

nina: thanks all. plan: liz copy PR, ava to add header icon to Figma, jordan to send audit event example to infra, katie to validate a11y. Ping here if you find anything that suggests we claim key access. :thumbsup:
